task_intake.measurable_outcome: Record an evidence-backed v0.1.1 post-release review and an unambiguous finite v1.0.0 exit contract without changing the product or publishing a release.
completion_criteria: v0.1.1 release, repository, issue, security-alert and usage observations are classified without overstating evidence
the terminal v1.0.0 product definition and frozen public contract are explicit
exactly three ordinary future blocks are named and remain proposed_not_authorized
additional routine 0.1.x releases are forbidden unless a named exit criterion fails
the contract, mutations, focused tests, evidence and successor manifest pass locally and in hosted assurance
protected_artifacts: immutable GitHub Releases v0.1.0 and v0.1.1
v0.1.1 package metadata, CLI, schemas, artifacts and exit-code semantics
registered datasets, protocols, seeds, splits, metrics, rounding and verdict semantics
stop_conditions: a severity-high correctness, integrity, security or supported-cell compatibility defect is evidenced
the stable public contract cannot be stated without a breaking product change
a required change falls outside the planned change set or changes scientific scope
publication, tag creation, package-index upload or a future block would be required

feedback_and_security.interpretation: No user feedback or security alert is known, but zero downloads means field reliability and adoption cannot be inferred. Version-update PRs are maintenance proposals, not vulnerability evidence.

post_release_observations.uncertainty: The repository has no external usage telemetry beyond GitHub counters; absence of reports is not evidence of absence of defects.

terminal_product_definition.definition: A stable bounded offline evidence auditor that determines whether registered experimental evidence supports a stated machine-learning claim; it is not a universal model-selection platform.
required_product_surface: versioned local UTF-8 CSV inputs and JSON claim specifications
bounded binary tabular classification with the fixed allowlisted model family
bounded exchangeable-row tabular regression with the fixed allowlisted model family
mlcra audit, verify, doctor and dashboard commands
deterministic integrity-verifiable bundles and fail-closed diagnostics
reproducible hash-bound sdist and wheel with immutable GitHub provenance
current security, legal, citation, dataset and scientific-scope disclosures
explicit_non_goals: multiclass, time-series, grouped or spatial protocols
arbitrary pickle, joblib, plugin imports or remote URLs
automatic hyperparameter search or open-ended model discovery
a hosted dashboard, service or telemetry platform
platforms or Python cells outside the declared support boundary
terminal_product_definition.completion_semantics: After immutable GitHub v1.0.0 is verified and accepted, the declared project-development goal is complete. Later work is maintenance or separately authorized feature development, not an automatic continuation of this release train.

public_contract_freeze.compatibility_rule: ST08_16A may only finalize version, classifier and documentation surfaces. It must not break existing v0.1.1 commands, schemas, artifact meaning or exit-code semantics.
public_contract_freeze.classifier_interpretation: Stable within the explicitly bounded supported cell; it does not claim broad production adoption or support outside that cell.

blocking_conditions: any unresolved high or critical dependency vulnerability affecting the supported cell
any supported-cell installation, compatibility or regression failure
any unresolved correctness or integrity defect mapped to an exit criterion
dependency_and_feedback_policy.usage_evidence_rule: External adoption is reported when observed but is not a prerequisite for this bounded artifact-and-contract assurance release. Lack of telemetry remains a limitation.
